recognize_zh: 三色染色（trichrome）下骨小樑呈藍色，小樑間髓腔內也可見藍色膠原纖維束穿行，造血細胞稀少、只剩散在紅色細胞與脂肪空泡，代表成熟膠原沉積的晚期骨髓纖維化（collagen grade ≥2）。
features: Bony trabeculae stain blue, irregular and somewhat thickened
Intertrabecular spaces contain wavy blue collagen fibers forming streaming bundles and a loose meshwork
Sparse hematopoietic elements (red-staining cells) and scattered fat vacuoles; overall hypocellular
Streaming, fibrotic architecture without recognizable normal marrow organization
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy stained with Masson trichrome shows irregular blue-staining trabeculae and intertrabecular marrow replaced by a loose to streaming meshwork of blue collagen fibers. Hematopoietic elements are sparse, appearing as scattered red-staining cells among adipocytes. The presence of trichrome-positive mature collagen indicates advanced fibrosis (collagen grade 2 or higher in the WHO/ESMO scheme), consistent with long-standing, fibrotic-stage myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Early fibrosis is highlighted by reticulin stain but shows no blue collagen on trichrome, unlike this case.
Collagenous stroma would surround cohesive keratin-positive tumor nests, which are not seen here.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia or systemic mastocytosis with fibrosis
ddx.vs: These show an interstitial neoplastic infiltrate (CD20/annexin A1 or CD117/tryptase-positive) within the fibrosis rather than hypocellular collagenous stroma.
Morphologically similar; distinguished by treatment history and absence of an MPN driver mutation.
